title: Clinical Trial of Ruxian Zengsheng No. 1 Decoction
brief_summary: A prospective, open, randomized, controlled phase II clinical study is planned to clarify the efficacy and related adverse reactions of Mammary Glandular Hyperplasia No. 1 Decoction in the treatment of liver-qi stagnation type breast hyperplasia, relieve the pain of patients with breast hyperplasia, and improve the quality of life of patients.
